description: This is a PHP unit test class for the OrganizationDao component of the OrangeHRM system, specifically testing organization data retrieval and persistence functions within the admin DAO module.

classes.name: OrganizationDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing OrganizationDao functionalities such as retrieving and saving organization information.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes DAO instances and populates test fixture data before each test.

methods.name: testGetOrganizationGeneralInformation
methods.description: Verifies that the method getOrganizationGeneralInformation returns an Organization object.

methods.name: testSaveOrganizationGeneralInformation
methods.description: Tests saving new organization data and verifies persistence and updates.
